006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.CastFunctionException;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IQNameItem;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
018import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
019import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
020
021import java.net.URI;
022import java.net.URISyntaxException;
023import java.util.List;
024
025import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
026
027/**
028 * /** Implements
029 * <a href= "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-QName">fn:QName</a>
030 * functions.
031 */
032public final class FnQName {
033  @NonNull
034  private static final String NAME = "QName";
035
036  @NonNull
037  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
038      .name(NAME)
039      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
040      .deterministic()
041      .contextIndependent()
042      .focusIndependent()
043      .argument(IArgument.builder()
044          .name("paramURI")
045          .type(IStringItem.type())
046          .zeroOrOne()
047          .build())
048      .argument(IArgument.builder()
049          .name("paramQName")
050          .type(IStringItem.type())
051          .one()
052          .build())
053      .returnType(IQNameItem.type())
054      .returnOne()
055      .functionHandler(FnQName::execute)
056      .build();
057
058  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
059  @NonNull
060  private static ISequence<IQNameItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
061      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
062      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
063      IItem focus) {
064    IStringItem paramUri = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true));
065    IStringItem paramQName = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true)));
066
067    IEnhancedQName result;
068    if (paramUri == null) {
069      result = IEnhancedQName.of(paramQName.asString());
070    } else {
071      if (paramUri.length() == 0) {
072        throw new CastFunctionException(
073            CastFunctionException.INVALID_LEXICAL_VALUE,
074            paramUri,
075            String.format("paramURI is an empty string and not a valid URI to form a QName."));
076      }
077
078      URI uri;
079      try {
080        uri = ObjectUtils.notNull(new URI(paramUri.asString()));
081      } catch (URISyntaxException ex) {
082        throw new CastFunctionException(
083            CastFunctionException.INVALID_LEXICAL_VALUE,
084            paramUri,
085            String.format("paramURI '%s' is not a valid URI to form a QName.", paramUri.asString()),
086            ex);
087      }
088      result = IEnhancedQName.of(uri, paramQName.asString());
089    }
090    return ISequence.of(IQNameItem.valueOf(result));
091  }
092
093  private FnQName() {
094    // disable construction
095  }
096}
